retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring a central musician with an electric guitar, layered over repetitive, dripping graffiti-style typography on a clean white background.
triggerTerms: layered red and black brush lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A central full-body portrait of a musician in a power stance with an electric guitar, set against a stark white background filled with repetitive, hand-painted black graffiti that is partially obscured by a large, vibrant red brush-stroke title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and overlapping background text
High-contrast black and white base with a single red accent color
Repetitive background pattern created by dripping paint typography
Aggressive brush textures contrasting with clean studio photography
coreInvariants: Dripping paint effect on background lettering
Central subject overlapping the primary title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, scaled to occupy the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the vibrant red title text across the mid-section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the red title, then radiates outward to the repetitive black graffiti.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the white background is heavily populated by text, though it remains the primary negative space element.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with a single high-saturation red focal point.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif with irregular, expressive proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent x-heights for a raw, hand-drawn feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature elongated vertical strokes to facilitate dripping effects.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Layered repetition of the same custom style in contrasting colors.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, dripping energy of the background text.
Matches the thick, bold presence of the red title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a musician with an electric guitar on a white background, surrounded by repetitive black graffiti-style brush strokes with paint drips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, vibrant red hand-painted title across the center, using a dry-brush texture that overlaps the subject's legs and the background text.

verificationChecks: Ensure paint drips are visible on black text
Check that red text is the most saturated element
Verify subject is centered and in a power stance

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard clean sans-serif fonts
Do not use gradients in the text

mustAchieve: Dynamic layering of text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Is the red text clearly legible against the black and white?
Do the paint drips look organic rather than procedural?
Is the subject's silhouette sharp against the white background?
Does the composition feel energetic and 'rock-and-roll'?
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + high-key white background + repetitive dripping black graffiti + bold red brush-stroke title overlay.
